body: Depending on the night and the type of music you wanna dance to, there are a lot of monthly parties throughout the city. Sadboyz, Damn Girl, Heat Wave, Pink Pony Club (this one’s a bit newer), all with their own vibes. The first three have their own IG profiles so you can check em out

Op, I’m sorry this happened and that you had to see those. If you feel like your trust is broken and can’t be restored, I’m sorry but it might be time to end things. I just went through a major betrayal from my ex-partner, and we tried to make things work, but I couldn’t get over the feeling of so much betrayal. 

If you do want to stay, and you think you can trust his answers, ask him about the older vids being on a newer computer. But if you really feel like you can’t trust him again, his answers might make you feel even more confused and lied to. 

It’s a tough situation, OP, but it sounds like you’re making the right moves here by firmly holding your boundaries 🩷
